name: manual_950bfe
claim: On Windows, Python subprocess cannot execute npm.cmd or npx.cmd. Resolve the shim with shutil.which and run it through cmd /c. WinError 2 after the shim is on PATH means the launcher found the command and then invoked it incorrectly.

decisions.notes: ensure_ai_cli_mcp.py reported Node supported and then could not execute npm list because CreateProcess does not run .cmd files from an argument list.

rationale: ensure_ai_cli_mcp.py reported Node supported and then could not execute npm list because CreateProcess does not run .cmd files from an argument list.
